Lua addon API reference¶

Complete reference for the Shroud* API exposed to player addons, generated from the host bindings in LuaManager.cs (plus LuaInkApi.cs for the Ink bridge). See the authoring guide for how to write and install addons, and host internals for how the runtime is wired. For a token-dense version aimed at AI coding agents, see the agent reference.

How to read this reference¶

Each category opens with a quick-reference table; every function name links down to a full entry with its signature, parameters, return value, and a short Lua example. Types are given in Lua terms (number, string, boolean, table, list, nil) rather than the underlying C# types.

Conventions. Unless noted, a function is valid only inside a callback (the API is registered after addon files load). Indices are 0-based, except the sound API (noted there). Failure sentinels: numbers return -999 (the global InvalidStatResult), names return "INVALID" or "None", objects return nil. The current API version (ShroudLuaApiVersion) is 3.

Callbacks¶

Callbacks are functions your addon defines; the host looks them up by name and calls them. Register one by declaring a global function with the exact name in your addon file — the loader captures it once, right after your file finishes running (ShroudOnStart also fires at that moment). Every callback is optional; define only the ones you need. A callback that throws is caught per-call and does not stop the other addons.

Callback Signature When it fires
ShroudOnStart ShroudOnStart() Once, when the addon loads and is enabled
ShroudOnUpdate ShroudOnUpdate() Every frame while the addon is enabled
ShroudOnGUI ShroudOnGUI() During Unity's IMGUI pass (legacy immediate-mode drawing only)
ShroudOnConsoleInput ShroudOnConsoleInput(inputType, sourcePlayer, message) For each chat/console line received
ShroudOnExperienceGain ShroudOnExperienceGain(experienceType, amount) When the player gains character experience
ShroudOnExperienceChanged ShroudOnExperienceChanged(experienceType, amount) Alias of ShroudOnExperienceGain
ShroudOnMouseOver ShroudOnMouseOver(id, kind) Mouse enters a Lua widget with an in/out listener
ShroudOnMouseOut ShroudOnMouseOut(id, kind) Mouse leaves a Lua widget with an in/out listener
ShroudOnMouseClick ShroudOnMouseClick(id, kind) A Lua widget with a click listener is clicked
ShroudOnInputChange ShroudOnInputChange(id, text) A Lua input field's text changes
ShroudOnToggleChange ShroudOnToggleChange(id, isOn) A Lua toggle's state changes
ShroudOnSceneLoaded ShroudOnSceneLoaded(sceneName) A non-login scene finishes loading
ShroudOnSceneUnloaded ShroudOnSceneUnloaded() A scene unloads
ShroudOnLogOut ShroudOnLogOut() The login scene loads (logout / return to login)
ShroudOnPlaySound ShroudOnPlaySound(clipName) A UI audio clip plays
ShroudOnPlayFX ShroudOnPlayFX(fxName, on) A visual FX starts or ends near the player
ShroudOnPlayEmote ShroudOnPlayEmote(emote) The local player performs an emote via ShroudPlayEmote
ShroudOnDisableScript ShroudOnDisableScript() The addon is disabled

ShroudOnStart¶

ShroudOnStart()

  • No arguments.
  • Fires once, when the addon file has finished loading and the addon is enabled (also re-fires if the addon is reloaded). Use it for one-time setup: build your UI, read saved variables, register periodics. Per-frame globals such as ShroudPlayerX are already valid here.
function ShroudOnStart()
  greeting = "Hello, " .. ShroudGetPlayerName()
  panelId = ShroudUIPanel(10, 10, 200, 60)
  labelId = ShroudUIText(greeting, 18, 20, 20, 180, 40)
  ShroudSetTextParent(labelId, panelId)
end

ShroudOnUpdate¶

ShroudOnUpdate()

  • No arguments.
  • Fires every frame while the addon is enabled, before the GUI pass. Keep the body cheap; heavy work here costs frame rate. Read per-frame globals (ShroudPlayerCurrentHealth, ShroudTime, ShroudDeltaTime, ShroudMouseX/Y) from inside it.
local accum = 0
function ShroudOnUpdate()
  accum = accum + ShroudDeltaTime
  if accum >= 1.0 then
    accum = 0
    ShroudModifyText(labelId, "HP: " .. ShroudPlayerCurrentHealth)
  end
end

ShroudOnGUI¶

ShroudOnGUI()

  • No arguments.
  • Fires during Unity's IMGUI OnGUI pass (may run more than once per frame). This is the only place the legacy immediate-mode drawing calls (ShroudGUILabel, ShroudButton, ShroudButtonRepeat, ShroudDrawTexture) are valid. Retained widgets do not need it. The immediate-mode API is being phased out; prefer retained widgets for new addons.
function ShroudOnGUI()
  ShroudGUILabel(10, 80, 210, 100, "Frame time: " .. ShroudDeltaTime)
end

ShroudOnConsoleInput¶

ShroudOnConsoleInput(inputType: string, sourcePlayer: string, message: string)

  • inputType (string): the chat channel/type name, e.g. "Say", "Whisper", "Party" (from the message's channel).
  • sourcePlayer (string): the display name of the player who sent the line.
  • message (string): the full message text as it appears in chat.
  • Fires once for each incoming chat/console line. It is a notification only — the return value is ignored and the message is not altered.
function ShroudOnConsoleInput(inputType, sourcePlayer, message)
  if inputType == "Whisper" then
    ShroudConsoleLog(sourcePlayer .. " whispered you.")
  end
end

ShroudOnExperienceGain¶

ShroudOnExperienceGain(experienceType: string, amount: number)

  • experienceType (string): "Adventurer" or "Producer".
  • amount (number): the experience just gained (always positive; the callback only fires when the delta is greater than zero).
  • Fires when the player's character experience increases. ShroudOnExperienceChanged is an accepted alias for the same event — define either name (not both). See ShroudOnExperienceChanged.
function ShroudOnExperienceGain(experienceType, amount)
  if experienceType == "Producer" then
    sessionCraftXP = (sessionCraftXP or 0) + amount
  end
end

ShroudOnExperienceChanged¶

ShroudOnExperienceChanged(experienceType: string, amount: number)

  • experienceType (string): "Adventurer" or "Producer".
  • amount (number): the experience just gained (positive).
  • Alias of ShroudOnExperienceGain — same arguments, same firing rule. The loader accepts either name and prefers ShroudOnExperienceGain if both happen to be defined, so define only one.
function ShroudOnExperienceChanged(experienceType, amount)
  ShroudConsoleLog("Gained " .. amount .. " " .. experienceType .. " XP")
end

ShroudOnMouseOver¶

ShroudOnMouseOver(id: number, kind: UI)

  • id (number): the 0-based index of the widget within its kind's list (the value returned when you created it).
  • kind (enum UI): which widget kind — UI.Button, UI.Panel, UI.Image, or UI.Text.
  • Fires when the mouse enters a Lua-created widget that has an in/out listener attached (ShroudSetInOutListener). Widgets without the listener do not report.
function ShroudOnMouseOver(id, kind)
  if kind == UI.Button and id == myButtonId then
    ShroudSetButtonColor(myButtonId, ButtonMode.Normal, "#FFFF00FF")
  end
end

ShroudOnMouseOut¶

ShroudOnMouseOut(id: number, kind: UI)

  • id (number): the 0-based index of the widget within its kind's list.
  • kind (enum UI): the widget kind — UI.Button, UI.Panel, UI.Image, or UI.Text.
  • Fires when the mouse leaves a Lua widget that has an in/out listener (ShroudSetInOutListener). Gotcha: the primary listener path passes kind as a UI enum value, but a secondary pointer-exit path passes it as a plain string ("Button", "Panel", "Image", "Text"); compare defensively if you branch on kind here.
function ShroudOnMouseOut(id, kind)
  if id == myButtonId then
    ShroudSetButtonColor(myButtonId, ButtonMode.Normal, "#FFFFFFFF")
  end
end

ShroudOnMouseClick¶

ShroudOnMouseClick(id: number, kind: UI)

  • id (number): the 0-based index of the clicked widget within its kind's list.
  • kind (enum UI): the widget kind — UI.Button, UI.Panel, UI.Image, or UI.Text.
  • Fires when a Lua widget that has a click listener (ShroudSetClickListener) is clicked.
function ShroudOnMouseClick(id, kind)
  if kind == UI.Image and id == closeIconId then
    ShroudHideLuaUI()
  end
end

ShroudOnInputChange¶

ShroudOnInputChange(id: number, text: string)

  • id (number): the 0-based index of the input widget (as returned by ShroudUIInput).
  • text (string): the input field's current text after the change.
  • Fires whenever the text of a Lua input field changes.
function ShroudOnInputChange(id, text)
  if id == searchBoxId then
    lastQuery = text
  end
end

ShroudOnToggleChange¶

ShroudOnToggleChange(id: number, isOn: boolean)

  • id (number): the 0-based index of the toggle widget (as returned by ShroudUIToggle).
  • isOn (boolean): the toggle's new state.
  • Fires whenever a Lua toggle's checked state changes.
function ShroudOnToggleChange(id, isOn)
  if id == showTimerToggleId then
    if isOn then ShroudShowObject(timerPanelId, UI.Panel)
    else ShroudHideObject(timerPanelId, UI.Panel) end
  end
end

ShroudOnSceneLoaded¶

ShroudOnSceneLoaded(sceneName: string)

  • sceneName (string): the display name of the scene that finished loading (e.g. the friendly area name, not necessarily the raw scene id).
  • Fires after a non-login scene finishes loading. It does not fire for the login scene — that path calls ShroudOnLogOut instead.
function ShroudOnSceneLoaded(sceneName)
  ShroudConsoleLog("Entered: " .. sceneName)
  inTown = (sceneName ~= nil)
end

ShroudOnSceneUnloaded¶

ShroudOnSceneUnloaded()

  • No arguments.
  • Fires when a scene unloads (leaving an area, before the next scene loads). Use it to tear down per-scene state or pause work while no world scene is active.
function ShroudOnSceneUnloaded()
  trackedTargets = {}
end

ShroudOnLogOut¶

ShroudOnLogOut()

  • No arguments.
  • Fires when the login scene loads — that is, when the player logs out or otherwise returns to the login screen. Saved variables are flushed by the host around this point, so this is a natural place to finalize session totals. Note the name uses LogOut (capital O).
function ShroudOnLogOut()
  ShroudSetSavedVar("sessionCraftXP", sessionCraftXP or 0)
  ShroudFlushSavedVars()
end

ShroudOnPlaySound¶

ShroudOnPlaySound(clipName: string)

  • clipName (string): the name of the audio clip being played (the clip asset's name).
  • Fires when a UI audio clip is played through the game's audio manager. It reports UI sounds, not arbitrary world audio.
function ShroudOnPlaySound(clipName)
  if clipName == "ui_error" then
    errorBlinkUntil = ShroudTime + 1.0
  end
end

ShroudOnPlayFX¶

ShroudOnPlayFX(fxName: string, on: boolean)

  • fxName (string): the name of the FX object (its GameObject name).
  • on (boolean): true when the effect starts, false when it ends.
  • Fires when a visual FX starts or ends near the local player. Suppressed while the player is in GM ghost mode. Each effect fires once for its start and once for its end.
function ShroudOnPlayFX(fxName, on)
  if on then
    activeFx[fxName] = true
  else
    activeFx[fxName] = nil
  end
end

ShroudOnPlayEmote¶

ShroudOnPlayEmote(emote: string)

  • emote (string): the name of the emote that was performed.
  • Fires when the local player performs an emote via ShroudPlayEmote — a self-action the addon (or player) just triggered, and only when the emote actually plays (the avatar must own it and be on the ground). It does not report other players' emotes.
function ShroudOnPlayEmote(emote)
  ShroudConsoleLog("You performed: " .. emote)
end

ShroudOnDisableScript¶

ShroudOnDisableScript()

  • No arguments.
  • Fires when the addon is disabled (from the addon UI or by the host), just before the addon stops running. Use it to persist state and clean up. After it returns the addon is marked disabled and its other callbacks stop firing.
function ShroudOnDisableScript()
  ShroudSetSavedVar("sessionCraftXP", sessionCraftXP or 0)
  ShroudFlushSavedVars()
  ShroudDestroyObject(panelId, UI.Panel)
end

Per-frame globals and constants¶

These are values the host writes into the Lua environment, not functions the addon calls. Read them like any Lua variable (local x = ShroudPlayerX); do not invoke them. The per-frame values are refreshed by the host on every frame while at least one addon is enabled, so a fresh read each frame reflects current state. (Internally most use a dirty-check and are only re-pushed when they change, but the value an addon reads is always current.) The constants below are written once, before any addon file runs, so they are safe to read at the top level of an addon file as well as inside callbacks.

Per-frame values¶

Global Type Meaning Updated
ShroudPlayerX number Local player world X position Every frame
ShroudPlayerY number Local player world Y position Every frame
ShroudPlayerZ number Local player world Z position Every frame
ShroudPlayerCurrentHealth number Local player current health Every frame
ShroudPlayerCurrentFocus number Local player current focus Every frame
ShroudPlayerGold number Local player gold total Every frame
ShroudTime number Engine time in seconds since start (Time.time) Every frame
ShroudDeltaTime number Frame delta in seconds, clamped at the Maximum Allowed Timestep (~0.1 s). Use this to pace animation Every frame
ShroudRealDeltaTime number Unclamped wall-clock frame delta in seconds; reflects the true length of a stall Every frame
ShroudServerTime string Server UTC time, formatted as a string (updated once per whole second) Every frame
ShroudMouseX number Mouse X in pixels Every frame
ShroudMouseY number Mouse Y in pixels, top-left origin (screenHeight - mouseY) Every frame

Set-once constants¶

Constant Type Meaning
ShroudLuaApiVersion number Current API version. Presently 3
ShroudLuaPath string Absolute path to the addon's Lua folder
ShroudDataPath string Absolute path to the addon data folder
InvalidStatResult number The numeric failure sentinel, -999. Stat/value getters return this when a value is hidden or the query is invalid

Enums and helper types¶

Registered static types available to every addon. Reference members by dotted name, e.g. UI.Image, AudioType.OGGVORBIS, TextAnchor.MiddleCenter.

  • UI — widget/object kind: Panel, Image, Text, Button, None, Toggle, Input.
  • ButtonMode — button visual state for ShroudSetButtonColor/ShroudSetButtonImage: Highlighted, Pressed, Disabled, Normal, None.
  • Transition — button transition for ShroudSetButtonTransition: None, ColorTint, SpriteSwap.
  • ContentType — input field content type for ShroudSetInputContentType: Standard, Autocorrected, IntegerNumber, DecimalNumber, Alphanumeric, Name, EmailAddress, Password, Pin, Custom.
  • AudioType — Unity's audio-format enum passed to ShroudLoadSound. Practical members: WAV, OGGVORBIS, MPEG, AIFF (the enum also carries tracker/console formats such as IT, MOD, S3M, XM, plus UNKNOWN).
  • TextAnchor — Unity's text alignment enum passed to ShroudSetTextAlignment: UpperLeft, UpperCenter, UpperRight, MiddleLeft, MiddleCenter, MiddleRight, LowerLeft, LowerCenter, LowerRight.
  • LuaVector2 — fields x, y (number). Returned by ShroudGetPosition.
  • LuaVector3 — fields x, y, z (number). Returned by ShroudWorldToScreenPoint.

Examples¶

Reading a few per-frame globals inside ShroudOnUpdate:

function ShroudOnUpdate()
    -- current player position and vitals
    local x, y, z = ShroudPlayerX, ShroudPlayerY, ShroudPlayerZ
    local hp = ShroudPlayerCurrentHealth

    -- pace an animation with the clamped delta, but measure stalls with the real one
    myTimer = myTimer + ShroudDeltaTime
    if ShroudRealDeltaTime > 0.25 then
        ShroudConsoleLog("frame stall: " .. ShroudRealDeltaTime .. "s")
    end

    -- ShroudMouseY is top-left origin (screenHeight - mouseY)
    ShroudConsoleLog("mouse: " .. ShroudMouseX .. ", " .. ShroudMouseY)
end

Passing an enum value to a widget call:

-- create an image widget, then recolor it via its UI kind
local id = ShroudUIImage(100, 100, 64, 64, textureId, 0, UI.None, 0)
ShroudSetColor(id, UI.Image, "#FF8800")

-- load an OGG sound using the AudioType enum
ShroudLoadSound("sfx/ping.ogg", AudioType.OGGVORBIS)

Gotchas¶

  • ShroudDeltaTime is clamped; ShroudRealDeltaTime is not. ShroudDeltaTime never exceeds the Maximum Allowed Timestep (~0.1 s), so a longer frame (a load hitch, an alt-tab) reports at most ~0.1 s. Use it to advance animation smoothly. When you need the true elapsed wall-clock time for a frame — for example to detect or measure a stall — read ShroudRealDeltaTime, which is unclamped.
  • ShroudMouseY uses a top-left origin. It is screenHeight - mouseY, so 0 is the top of the screen and it increases downward, opposite Unity's bottom-left Input.mousePosition. ShroudMouseX matches Unity directly.

Character and stats¶

These functions read the local player: identity, orientation, combat state, character stats, active buffs, and experience pools. They are only valid inside a callback. Nearly all short-circuit when there is no local player yet and return a sentinel: numbers return -999 (the global InvalidStatResult) or 0, stat names return "INVALID", buff names return "Invalid", buff times return -1, and list/table getters return nil. Stat indices are 0-based and run 0 .. ShroudGetStatCount()-1, but many stat slots are hidden from Lua and yield the sentinel even for a valid index.

Function Call What it does
ShroudGetPlayerName ShroudGetPlayerName() Local player display name
ShroudGetPlayerCombatMode ShroudGetPlayerCombatMode() True while in combat
ShroudGetPlayerOrientation ShroudGetPlayerOrientation() Facing angle in degrees
ShroudGetStatCount ShroudGetStatCount() Number of stat slots
ShroudGetStatValueByNumber ShroudGetStatValueByNumber(number) Stat value by index
ShroudGetStatNameByNumber ShroudGetStatNameByNumber(number) Stat enum name by index
ShroudGetStatDescriptionByNumber ShroudGetStatDescriptionByNumber(number) Stat display name by index
ShroudGetStatValueByName ShroudGetStatValueByName(statName) Stat value by name
ShroudGetBuffCount ShroudGetBuffCount() Count of active effects
ShroudGetBuffName ShroudGetBuffName(index) Buff rune name by index
ShroudGetBuffDescription ShroudGetBuffDescription(index) Buff display name by index
ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining(index) Seconds left on a buff
ShroudGetBuffIcon ShroudGetBuffIcon(index) Texture id of a buff's real skill icon
ShroudGetBuffTooltip ShroudGetBuffTooltip(index) Native-matching tooltip text for a buff
ShroudGetPlayerBuff ShroudGetPlayerBuff() Buffs grouped by rune
ShroudGetPooledAdventurerExperience ShroudGetPooledAdventurerExperience() Unspent pooled adventurer XP
ShroudGetPooledProducerExperience ShroudGetPooledProducerExperience() Unspent pooled producer XP
ShroudGetTotalAdventurerExperience ShroudGetTotalAdventurerExperience() Total adventurer XP
ShroudGetTotalProducerExperience ShroudGetTotalProducerExperience() Total producer XP
ShroudGetAttenuationAdventurerStatus ShroudGetAttenuationAdventurerStatus() Adventurer XP attenuated now
ShroudGetAttenuationProducerStatus ShroudGetAttenuationProducerStatus() Producer XP attenuated now

ShroudGetPlayerName¶

ShroudGetPlayerName() -> string

  • Returns: string, the local player's display name; "none" when there is no local player.
function ShroudOnStart()
    ShroudConsoleLog("Playing as " .. ShroudGetPlayerName())
end

ShroudGetPlayerCombatMode¶

ShroudGetPlayerCombatMode() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean, true while the player is in combat, otherwise false (also false when there is no player).
function ShroudOnUpdate(dt)
    if ShroudGetPlayerCombatMode() then
        ShroudConsoleLog("In combat")
    end
end

ShroudGetPlayerOrientation¶

ShroudGetPlayerOrientation() -> number

  • Returns: number, the player's facing as the rounded Y euler angle in degrees (0 to 360); 0 when there is no player.
function ShroudOnUpdate(dt)
    local facing = ShroudGetPlayerOrientation()
    ShroudConsoleLog("Facing " .. facing .. " degrees")
end

ShroudGetStatCount¶

ShroudGetStatCount() -> number

  • Returns: number, the total count of stat slots (the size of the stat enum). Valid stat indices are 0 .. count-1.
  • Notes: This is the full slot count, not the count of readable stats. Many slots are hidden from Lua, so iterating all of them will still hit sentinels on the hidden ones.
for i = 0, ShroudGetStatCount() - 1 do
    local name = ShroudGetStatNameByNumber(i)
    if name ~= "INVALID" then
        ShroudConsoleLog(name .. " = " .. ShroudGetStatValueByNumber(i))
    end
end

ShroudGetStatValueByNumber¶

ShroudGetStatValueByNumber(number: number) -> number

  • number: number, the 0-based stat index in 0 .. ShroudGetStatCount()-1.
  • Returns: number, the stat value; -999 (InvalidStatResult) when there is no player, the index is out of range, or the stat is hidden from Lua.
local str = ShroudGetStatValueByNumber(0)
if str ~= InvalidStatResult then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Stat 0 = " .. str)
end

ShroudGetStatNameByNumber¶

ShroudGetStatNameByNumber(number: number) -> string

  • number: number, the 0-based stat index in 0 .. ShroudGetStatCount()-1.
  • Returns: string, the stat's internal enum name (for example Strength); "INVALID" when there is no player, the index is out of range, or the stat is hidden.
  • Notes: This is the code name. Use ShroudGetStatDescriptionByNumber for the localized label.
ShroudConsoleLog("Stat 0 name: " .. ShroudGetStatNameByNumber(0))

ShroudGetStatDescriptionByNumber¶

ShroudGetStatDescriptionByNumber(number: number) -> string

  • number: number, the 0-based stat index in 0 .. ShroudGetStatCount()-1.
  • Returns: string, the stat's localized display name; "INVALID" when there is no player, the index is out of range, or the stat is hidden.
ShroudConsoleLog("Stat 0 label: " .. ShroudGetStatDescriptionByNumber(0))

ShroudGetStatValueByName¶

ShroudGetStatValueByName(statName: string) -> number

  • statName: string, the stat's internal enum name (as returned by ShroudGetStatNameByNumber, for example Strength).
  • Returns: number, the stat value; 0.0 when the name is a real stat but hidden from Lua; -999 (InvalidStatResult) when there is no player or the name is unknown.
  • Notes: The two failure cases differ. A hidden-but-real stat returns 0.0, so treat 0.0 as "not readable" rather than a true zero when the stat could be hidden.
local dex = ShroudGetStatValueByName("Dexterity")
if dex ~= InvalidStatResult then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Dexterity = " .. dex)
end

ShroudGetBuffCount¶

ShroudGetBuffCount() -> number

  • Returns: number, the count of active character effects on the player; 0 when there is no player or no effects.
  • Notes: This counts raw effect entries, which is the index space for ShroudGetBuffName, ShroudGetBuffDescription, and ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining. It is not the grouped-by-rune count returned by ShroudGetPlayerBuff.
local n = ShroudGetBuffCount()
for i = 0, n - 1 do
    ShroudConsoleLog(ShroudGetBuffName(i) .. ": " .. ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining(i) .. "s")
end

ShroudGetBuffName¶

ShroudGetBuffName(index: number) -> string

  • index: number, the 0-based effect index in 0 .. ShroudGetBuffCount()-1.
  • Returns: string, the buff's rune name; "Invalid" when there is no player or the index is out of range.
  • Notes: The sentinel here is "Invalid" (mixed case), unlike the stat functions which use "INVALID".
ShroudConsoleLog("First buff: " .. ShroudGetBuffName(0))

ShroudGetBuffDescription¶

ShroudGetBuffDescription(index: number) -> string

  • index: number, the 0-based effect index in 0 .. ShroudGetBuffCount()-1.
  • Returns: string, the buff's localized display name; "Invalid" when there is no player, the index is out of range, or the effect has no display name.

Same as ShroudGetBuffName but returns the localized label instead of the rune name.

ShroudConsoleLog("First buff label: " .. ShroudGetBuffDescription(0))

ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining¶

ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining(index: number) -> number

  • index: number, the 0-based effect index in 0 .. ShroudGetBuffCount()-1.
  • Returns: number, seconds remaining on the effect; -1 when there is no player or the index is out of range.
local secs = ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining(0)
if secs >= 0 then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Expires in " .. secs .. "s")
end

ShroudGetBuffIcon¶

ShroudGetBuffIcon(index: number) -> number

  • index: number, the 0-based effect index in 0 .. ShroudGetBuffCount()-1.
  • Returns: number, a texture id for the buff's real in-game skill icon (the same graphic the game's buff bar shows), usable directly with ShroudDrawTexture / ShroudDrawTextureTooltip. Returns -1 when there is no player, the index is out of range, or the rune has no skill icon (creature/NPC runes). (API v3)
  • Notes: The icon is resolved once per skill and cached, so calling this every frame is cheap. This means an addon no longer has to ship its own artwork to show recognizable buff icons.
local tex = ShroudGetBuffIcon(0)
if tex >= 0 then
    ShroudDrawTexture(40, 220, 40, 40, tex)
end

ShroudGetBuffTooltip¶

ShroudGetBuffTooltip(index: number) -> string

  • index: number, the 0-based effect index in 0 .. ShroudGetBuffCount()-1.
  • Returns: string, a plain-text tooltip mirroring the game's own buff bar: the skill name, the effect's description line (when it shows a tooltip), and the time remaining, each on its own line. Empty string when there is no player or the index is out of range. NGUI markup is already stripped, so it draws cleanly through the immediate-mode GUI. (API v3)
  • Notes: Pair with ShroudDrawTextureTooltip so hovering an icon tells the player which skill it is.
local tex = ShroudGetBuffIcon(0)
if tex >= 0 then
    ShroudDrawTextureTooltip(40, 220, 40, 40, tex, ShroudGetBuffTooltip(0))
end

ShroudGetPlayerBuff¶

ShroudGetPlayerBuff() -> list

  • Returns: list of rune tables, or nil when there is no player. Each entry is a RuneEffects table with fields RuneName (string), RuneId (number), IsDebuff (boolean), IconId (number — texture id of the real skill icon, or -1; same value as ShroudGetBuffIcon, API v3), StackCount (number), and Effects (a list of tables, each { Description, Value, CurrentDuration, TotalDuration, TotalTick }).
  • Notes: Effects are grouped by rune name, so this list is shorter than ShroudGetBuffCount when one rune applies several effect components. StackCount is the number of grouped effect entries, an upper bound on true stacks. The result is a fresh snapshot per call; build it once per frame rather than per widget.
local buffs = ShroudGetPlayerBuff()
if buffs then
    for _, rune in ipairs(buffs) do
        local tag = rune.IsDebuff and "debuff" or "buff"
        ShroudConsoleLog(rune.RuneName .. " (" .. tag .. ") x" .. rune.StackCount)
    end
end

ShroudGetPooledAdventurerExperience¶

ShroudGetPooledAdventurerExperience() -> number

  • Returns: number, the player's unspent pooled adventurer experience; 0 when there is no player or character data.
ShroudConsoleLog("Pooled adv XP: " .. ShroudGetPooledAdventurerExperience())

ShroudGetPooledProducerExperience¶

ShroudGetPooledProducerExperience() -> number

  • Returns: number, the player's unspent pooled producer experience; 0 when there is no player or character data.

Same as ShroudGetPooledAdventurerExperience but for the producer pool.

ShroudConsoleLog("Pooled prod XP: " .. ShroudGetPooledProducerExperience())

ShroudGetTotalAdventurerExperience¶

ShroudGetTotalAdventurerExperience() -> number

  • Returns: number, the player's total accumulated adventurer experience; 0 when there is no player or character data.
ShroudConsoleLog("Total adv XP: " .. ShroudGetTotalAdventurerExperience())

ShroudGetTotalProducerExperience¶

ShroudGetTotalProducerExperience() -> number

  • Returns: number, the player's total accumulated producer experience; 0 when there is no player or character data.

Same as ShroudGetTotalAdventurerExperience but for producer experience.

ShroudConsoleLog("Total prod XP: " .. ShroudGetTotalProducerExperience())

ShroudGetAttenuationAdventurerStatus¶

ShroudGetAttenuationAdventurerStatus() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean, true if adventurer experience is currently being attenuated (a reduced XP rate), otherwise false.
  • Notes: Reports true when the last adventurer attenuation event was under 15 minutes (900 seconds) ago.
if ShroudGetAttenuationAdventurerStatus() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Adventurer XP is attenuated")
end

ShroudGetAttenuationProducerStatus¶

ShroudGetAttenuationProducerStatus() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean, true if producer experience is currently being attenuated, otherwise false.

Same as ShroudGetAttenuationAdventurerStatus but for producer experience (also a 15-minute window).

if ShroudGetAttenuationProducerStatus() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Producer XP is attenuated")
end

Pet¶

These two functions read the player's active primary pet (a tamed creature or a summoned combat pet). Both take no arguments and both return nil when there is no local player or no primary pet out, so always nil-check before indexing. ShroudGetPetInfo returns a single stats table; ShroudGetPetBuff returns the same rune-effect list shape as the player buff calls. Note that several PetInfo fields (MoveSpeed, MoveRate, StrengthPower, TauntPower) are read off the local player, not the pet entity: three are the player's Taming skill stats and MoveRate is the player's general movement-rate stat.

Function Call What it does
ShroudGetPetInfo ShroudGetPetInfo() Returns a stats table for the active pet
ShroudGetPetBuff ShroudGetPetBuff() Returns the active pet's rune buffs/debuffs

ShroudGetPetInfo¶

ShroudGetPetInfo() -> table (or nil)

  • Returns: a PetInfo table, or nil if there is no local player or no primary pet. Fields:
  • Name (string) — pet display name.
  • Level (number) — adventurer level.
  • isSummon (boolean) — true if the pet is a summon, false if it is a tamed creature.
  • Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence (number) — pet attributes.
  • CurrentHealth, MaxHealth (number) — integer health values.
  • HealthRegen, HealthRegenCombat (number) — out-of-combat and in-combat health per second.
  • AttackSpeed (number).
  • Absorb, Resist, MagicResist (number) — total damage absorption, total damage resistance, magic resistance.
  • CriticalHit (number) — critical hit chance as a percentage.
  • TauntPower, StrengthPower, MoveSpeed, MoveRate (number).
  • Notes: MoveSpeed, StrengthPower, and TauntPower are read from the local player's Taming stats (TamingMoveSpeed, TamingStrength, TamingTaunt), and MoveRate is read from the local player's general movement-rate stat (MoveRate), not from the pet entity — so all four reflect your own character rather than the creature. CriticalHit is a derived percentage, not a raw stat.
local pet = ShroudGetPetInfo()
if pet then
    ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("%s (Lv %d) HP %d/%d, crit %.1f%%",
        pet.Name, pet.Level, pet.CurrentHealth, pet.MaxHealth, pet.CriticalHit))
    if pet.CurrentHealth < pet.MaxHealth * 0.3 then
        ShroudConsoleLog(pet.Name .. " is low on health")
    end
else
    ShroudConsoleLog("No pet out")
end

ShroudGetPetBuff¶

ShroudGetPetBuff() -> list (or nil)

  • Returns: a list of RuneEffects tables for the active pet, or nil if there is no local player or no primary pet. An empty list means the pet has no active effects. Each RuneEffects table has:
  • RuneName (string) — the rune's name.
  • RuneId (number) — the rune id.
  • IsDebuff (boolean) — true if the rune's disposition is hostile.
  • StackCount (number) — count of grouped effect entries under this rune. A single rune that applies several effect components counts each one, so this is an upper bound on true stacks, not an exact stack count.
  • Effects (list) — one BuffEffects table per effect component, each with Description (string, the stat type), Value (number), CurrentDuration (number, seconds remaining), TotalDuration (number, seconds), and TotalTick (number, tick length in seconds).
  • Notes: this is the same shape and grouping as the player buff call; effects are grouped by rune name in first-seen order.
local buffs = ShroudGetPetBuff()
if buffs then
    for i = 1, #buffs do
        local rune = buffs[i]
        local kind = rune.IsDebuff and "debuff" or "buff"
        ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("%s [%s] x%d", rune.RuneName, kind, rune.StackCount))
        for j = 1, #rune.Effects do
            local e = rune.Effects[j]
            ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("  %s = %.1f (%.0fs left)",
                e.Description, e.Value, e.CurrentDuration))
        end
    end
end

Target¶

These functions read the player's current target, resolved exactly like the on-screen target frame: the locked target if there is one, otherwise the closest valid combatant. Only combatants with replicated state count, so ShroudHasTarget gates everything else. Every value mirrors what the target frame shows and never more, so hidden-health creatures report a full bar and player targets expose only vitals. When there is no target the getters return their sentinel: numbers return -1, stat lookups return -999 (the global InvalidStatResult), names return "None" or "Invalid", and ShroudGetTargetBuff returns nil.

Function Call What it does
ShroudHasTarget ShroudHasTarget() True if a target is currently resolved
ShroudGetTargetName ShroudGetTargetName() Target display name
ShroudGetTargetId ShroudGetTargetId() Session-local id for detecting switches
ShroudIsTargetDead ShroudIsTargetDead() True if the target is dead
ShroudIsTargetHealthHidden ShroudIsTargetHealthHidden() True while the target hides its health
ShroudGetTargetCurrentHealth ShroudGetTargetCurrentHealth() Current health (max while hidden)
ShroudGetTargetMaxHealth ShroudGetTargetMaxHealth() Maximum health
ShroudGetTargetCurrentFocus ShroudGetTargetCurrentFocus() Current focus
ShroudGetTargetMaxFocus ShroudGetTargetMaxFocus() Maximum focus
ShroudGetTargetBuff ShroudGetTargetBuff() Buffs grouped by rune, with effects
ShroudGetTargetBuffCount ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() Raw effect-component count
ShroudGetTargetBuffName ShroudGetTargetBuffName(index) Rune name of one effect
ShroudGetTargetBuffDescription ShroudGetTargetBuffDescription(index) Display description of one effect
ShroudGetTargetBuffTimeRemaining ShroudGetTargetBuffTimeRemaining(index) Seconds left on one effect
ShroudGetTargetBuffIcon ShroudGetTargetBuffIcon(index) Texture id of a target buff's skill icon
ShroudGetTargetBuffTooltip ShroudGetTargetBuffTooltip(index) Native-matching tooltip for a target buff
ShroudGetTargetStatValueByNumber ShroudGetTargetStatValueByNumber(number) Target stat by index
ShroudGetTargetStatValueByName ShroudGetTargetStatValueByName(statName) Target stat by name

ShroudHasTarget¶

ShroudHasTarget() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean. true when a target is resolved and has replicated combat state, false otherwise.
  • Notes: use this as the guard before calling any other Target function; the rest return their no-target sentinels when this is false.
if ShroudHasTarget() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Target: " .. ShroudGetTargetName())
else
    ShroudConsoleLog("No target")
end

ShroudGetTargetName¶

ShroudGetTargetName() -> string

  • Returns: string, the target's display name. "None" when there is no target.
local name = ShroudGetTargetName()
if name ~= "None" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Fighting " .. name)
end

ShroudGetTargetId¶

ShroudGetTargetId() -> number

  • Returns: number, a session-local id stable while the target object lives. -1 when there is no target.
  • Notes: the value is not a persistent database id; it only serves to detect that the target changed between frames. Cache it and compare to spot a target switch.
local lastId = -1
ShroudOnUpdate = function()
    local id = ShroudGetTargetId()
    if id ~= lastId then
        lastId = id
        if id ~= -1 then
            ShroudConsoleLog("New target: " .. ShroudGetTargetName())
        end
    end
end

ShroudIsTargetDead¶

ShroudIsTargetDead() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean. true when the current target is dead, false when it is alive or when there is no target.
if ShroudHasTarget() and ShroudIsTargetDead() then
    ShroudConsoleLog(ShroudGetTargetName() .. " is dead")
end

ShroudIsTargetHealthHidden¶

ShroudIsTargetHealthHidden() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean. true while the target hides its health bar, false when the bar is visible or there is no target.
  • Notes: while this is true, ShroudGetTargetCurrentHealth reports the target's max health, matching the stock target frame. Check this before treating current health as a real value.
if ShroudIsTargetHealthHidden() then
    ShroudConsoleLog(ShroudGetTargetName() .. " conceals its health")
end

ShroudGetTargetCurrentHealth¶

ShroudGetTargetCurrentHealth() -> number

  • Returns: number, the target's current health. -1 when there is no target.
  • Notes: when the target hides its health (ShroudIsTargetHealthHidden is true) this returns the max health, not the true current value, exactly as the target frame displays it.
if ShroudHasTarget() then
    local cur = ShroudGetTargetCurrentHealth()
    local max = ShroudGetTargetMaxHealth()
    ShroudConsoleLog("HP " .. cur .. " / " .. max)
end

ShroudGetTargetMaxHealth¶

ShroudGetTargetMaxHealth() -> number

  • Returns: number, the target's maximum health. -1 when there is no target.
local max = ShroudGetTargetMaxHealth()
if max > 0 then
    local pct = 100 * ShroudGetTargetCurrentHealth() / max
    ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("Target at %.0f%%", pct))
end

ShroudGetTargetCurrentFocus¶

ShroudGetTargetCurrentFocus() -> number

  • Returns: number, the target's current focus. -1 when there is no target.
if ShroudHasTarget() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Focus: " .. ShroudGetTargetCurrentFocus())
end

ShroudGetTargetMaxFocus¶

ShroudGetTargetMaxFocus() -> number

  • Returns: number, the target's maximum focus. -1 when there is no target.
local maxFocus = ShroudGetTargetMaxFocus()
if maxFocus > 0 then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Max focus: " .. maxFocus)
end

ShroudGetTargetBuff¶

ShroudGetTargetBuff() -> list

  • Returns: a list (table) of buff entries, or nil when there is no target. Effects are grouped by rune name, so each entry is one rune. Each entry is a table with fields:
  • RuneName (string) — the rune's name.
  • RuneId (number) — the rune's numeric id.
  • IsDebuff (boolean) — true when the rune's disposition is hostile.
  • Effects (list) — one table per effect component under the rune, each with Description (string, the stat type), Value (number), CurrentDuration (number, seconds remaining), TotalDuration (number, seconds), and TotalTick (number, tick length).
  • StackCount (number) — the number of entries in Effects; an upper bound on true stacks, since one rune can apply several effect components.
  • Notes: this is the grouped view. It does not line up index-for-index with ShroudGetTargetBuffCount/ShroudGetTargetBuffName, which walk the raw un-grouped effect array.
local buffs = ShroudGetTargetBuff()
if buffs then
    for i = 1, #buffs do
        local b = buffs[i]
        local kind = b.IsDebuff and "debuff" or "buff"
        ShroudConsoleLog(b.RuneName .. " (" .. kind .. ", x" .. b.StackCount .. ")")
    end
end

ShroudGetTargetBuffCount¶

ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() -> number

  • Returns: number, the count of raw effect components on the target. 0 when there is no target or the target has no effects.
  • Notes: this counts the flat, un-grouped effect array that ShroudGetTargetBuffName, ShroudGetTargetBuffDescription, and ShroudGetTargetBuffTimeRemaining index into (0-based). It is generally larger than #ShroudGetTargetBuff(), which collapses effects by rune.
local count = ShroudGetTargetBuffCount()
for i = 0, count - 1 do
    ShroudConsoleLog(ShroudGetTargetBuffName(i))
end

ShroudGetTargetBuffName¶

ShroudGetTargetBuffName(index: number) -> string

  • index (number): 0-based position in the raw effect array, valid range 0 to ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() - 1.
  • Returns: string, the rune name of that effect. "Invalid" when there is no target or index is out of range.
for i = 0, ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() - 1 do
    local name = ShroudGetTargetBuffName(i)
    local secs = ShroudGetTargetBuffTimeRemaining(i)
    ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("%s: %.1fs", name, secs))
end

ShroudGetTargetBuffDescription¶

ShroudGetTargetBuffDescription(index: number) -> string

  • index (number): 0-based position in the raw effect array, valid range 0 to ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() - 1.
  • Returns: string, the effect's display description. "Invalid" when there is no target or index is out of range.
  • Notes: same raw-array indexing as ShroudGetTargetBuffName.
local first = ShroudGetTargetBuffDescription(0)
if first ~= "Invalid" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Top effect: " .. first)
end

ShroudGetTargetBuffTimeRemaining¶

ShroudGetTargetBuffTimeRemaining(index: number) -> number

  • index (number): 0-based position in the raw effect array, valid range 0 to ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() - 1.
  • Returns: number, seconds left on that effect (time to the end of the current tick plus the remaining ticks). -1 when there is no target or index is out of range.
local remaining = ShroudGetTargetBuffTimeRemaining(0)
if remaining >= 0 then
    ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("%.1f seconds left", remaining))
end

ShroudGetTargetBuffIcon¶

ShroudGetTargetBuffIcon(index: number) -> number

  • index (number): 0-based position in the raw effect array, valid range 0 to ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() - 1.
  • Returns: number, a texture id for the target buff's real skill icon (usable with ShroudDrawTexture / ShroudDrawTextureTooltip). -1 when there is no target, the index is out of range, or the rune has no skill icon. (API v3)

ShroudGetTargetBuffTooltip¶

ShroudGetTargetBuffTooltip(index: number) -> string

  • index (number): 0-based position in the raw effect array, valid range 0 to ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() - 1.
  • Returns: string, the same native-matching plain-text tooltip as ShroudGetBuffTooltip but for the current target's buff. Empty string when there is no target or the index is out of range. (API v3)

ShroudGetTargetStatValueByNumber¶

ShroudGetTargetStatValueByNumber(number: number) -> number

  • number (number): 0-based stat index, valid range 0 to ShroudGetStatCount() - 1.
  • Returns: number, the stat value. -999 (the global InvalidStatResult) when there is no target, number is out of range, the stat is never exposed, or the target is a player and the stat is not a vital.
  • Notes: player targets expose only their vitals (current/max health and focus); every other stat returns -999 for a player target. NPC and creature targets expose the full visible stat set. Stat indices match ShroudGetStatNameByNumber from the player Stats API.
if ShroudHasTarget() then
    for n = 0, ShroudGetStatCount() - 1 do
        local v = ShroudGetTargetStatValueByNumber(n)
        if v ~= -999 then
            ShroudConsoleLog(ShroudGetStatNameByNumber(n) .. " = " .. v)
        end
    end
end

ShroudGetTargetStatValueByName¶

ShroudGetTargetStatValueByName(statName: string) -> number

  • statName (string): the stat's name, as returned by ShroudGetStatNameByNumber.
  • Returns: number, the stat value. -999 (the global InvalidStatResult) when there is no target, the name is unknown, the stat is never exposed, or the target is a player and the stat is not a vital.
  • Notes: same player-target vitals-only rule as ShroudGetTargetStatValueByNumber. Unlike the player ShroudGetStatValueByName, a hidden-but-known stat here returns -999, not 0.
local str = ShroudGetTargetStatValueByName("Strength")
if str ~= -999 then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Target Strength: " .. str)
end

Under the mouse¶

These four functions report what the cursor is currently hovering, matching the client's own tooltip resolution (world object first, then UI) but without the display gating, so an addon can read the cursor even while a mouse button is held. All four read from a single snapshot that is resolved once per engine frame (building an item tooltip formats a whole stat block, so calling all four together costs no more than calling one). Text is localized and NGUI markup is stripped, so you get plain strings. When nothing readable is under the cursor the string getters return "", the kind returns "none", and the id returns -1.

Function Call What it does
ShroudGetDescriptionUnderMouse ShroudGetDescriptionUnderMouse() Full tooltip text under the cursor
ShroudGetNameUnderMouse ShroudGetNameUnderMouse() Title line only under the cursor
ShroudGetKindUnderMouse ShroudGetKindUnderMouse() Category of the thing under the cursor
ShroudGetIdUnderMouse ShroudGetIdUnderMouse() Session-local id of the hovered entity

ShroudGetDescriptionUnderMouse¶

ShroudGetDescriptionUnderMouse() -> string

  • Returns: string. The full tooltip text — the title line, then the body when the tooltip has one, joined with a newline. Markup is stripped and the text is trimmed. Returns "" when nothing readable is under the cursor.
  • Notes: For a world entity (player, NPC, item, container, object) the description falls back to the name when the entity carries no body text, so it is never empty while an entity is hovered. Resolved once per frame and shared with the other three getters.
local desc = ShroudGetDescriptionUnderMouse()
if desc ~= "" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Under mouse: " .. desc)
end

ShroudGetNameUnderMouse¶

ShroudGetNameUnderMouse() -> string

  • Returns: string. The title line only — item name, interact text, NPC or scene name. Markup stripped and trimmed. Returns "" when nothing readable is under the cursor.
  • Notes: Live NPCs and other players carry no tooltip, so their name is read from the entity's display name instead of a tooltip title.
local name = ShroudGetNameUnderMouse()
if name ~= "" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Hovering: " .. name)
end

ShroudGetKindUnderMouse¶

ShroudGetKindUnderMouse() -> string

  • Returns: string, one of "player", "npc", "item", "container", "deco", "object", "ui", or "none" when nothing is under the cursor. A world object that matches none of the specific kinds is reported as "object", never "none".
  • Notes: Item tooltips keep the "item" kind wherever they are shown (inventory, container, vendor list, mail), not just when the item lies in the world. Precedence for world objects: player, then npc, then item, then container, then deco, then object.
local kind = ShroudGetKindUnderMouse()
if kind == "npc" or kind == "player" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Mouse is over a " .. kind .. ": " .. ShroudGetNameUnderMouse())
end

ShroudGetIdUnderMouse¶

ShroudGetIdUnderMouse() -> number

  • Returns: number, a session-local id for the hovered world entity or decoration. Returns -1 when nothing is under the cursor, and also -1 for UI-sourced tooltips (an item hovered in inventory, a skill, a scene panel) where there is no world entity to identify.
  • Notes: The id is derived from the entity's runtime instance and is stable only within the current session; do not persist it or compare it across relogs. Resolved once per frame with the other three getters.
local id = ShroudGetIdUnderMouse()
local kind = ShroudGetKindUnderMouse()
if id ~= -1 then
    ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("Hovered %s id=%d name=%s", kind, id, ShroudGetNameUnderMouse()))
end

Party¶

These read the local player's current party. Two families exist: index-based getters keyed by a member's party UI slot, and in-scene getters keyed by a member's name. Everything fails soft and is safe to call when you are not in a party: counts return 0, names return "None" or an empty/nil list, and every health/focus getter returns -1. Note the split in name source and scope: ShroudGetPartyMemberName returns the character's full name from the whole party, while the health/focus getters (both families) only resolve members physically present in your current scene, so a valid slot index or party name can still return -1 when that member is elsewhere.

Function Call What it does
ShroudGetPartyMemberCount ShroudGetPartyMemberCount() Count of all party members
ShroudGetPartyMemberName ShroudGetPartyMemberName(index) Full name at a party UI slot
ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth(index) Current health by slot
ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealth ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealth(index) Max health by slot
ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocus ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocus(index) Current focus by slot
ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocus ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocus(index) Max focus by slot
ShroudGetPartyMemberCountInScene ShroudGetPartyMemberCountInScene() Party members in your scene
ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene() Names of in-scene members
ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene(name) Current health by name
ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealthInScene ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealthInScene(name) Max health by name
ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocusInScene ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocusInScene(name) Current focus by name
ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocusInScene ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocusInScene(name) Max focus by name

ShroudGetPartyMemberCount¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberCount() -> number

  • Returns: number, the total count of members in your party (including members not in your current scene). 0 when you are not in a party.
local n = ShroudGetPartyMemberCount()
ShroudConsoleLog("Party size: " .. n)

ShroudGetPartyMemberName¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberName(index: number) -> string

  • index: number, the party UI slot of the member. This is the member's assigned slot value, not a dense 0..count-1 enumeration, so a slot may be absent even when the count is higher.
  • Returns: string, the member's full name. "None" when no member occupies that slot or you are not in a party.
  • Notes: the name comes from the member's full character name. The in-scene health/focus getters match against the in-scene entity name, which can differ, so prefer the InScene family when reading vitals by name.
local count = ShroudGetPartyMemberCount()
for slot = 0, count - 1 do
  local name = ShroudGetPartyMemberName(slot)
  if name ~= "None" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Slot " .. slot .. ": " .. name)
  end
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth(index: number) -> number

  • index: number, the party UI slot of the member.
  • Returns: number, the member's current health. -1 when you are not in a party, the slot is empty, or that member is not present in your current scene.
  • Notes: resolves the slot to a name, then looks the member up among those in your current scene, so members in another scene always return -1 even though the slot is valid.
local slot = 0
local hp = ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth(slot)
if hp >= 0 then
  ShroudConsoleLog(ShroudGetPartyMemberName(slot) .. " HP: " .. hp)
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealth¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealth(index: number) -> number Same as ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth but returns the member's maximum health. -1 on the same failure and out-of-scene cases.

local slot = 0
local cur = ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth(slot)
local max = ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealth(slot)
if cur >= 0 and max > 0 then
  ShroudConsoleLog("Health: " .. cur .. " / " .. max)
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocus¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocus(index: number) -> number Same as ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth but returns the member's current focus. -1 on the same failure and out-of-scene cases.

local slot = 0
local fp = ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocus(slot)
if fp >= 0 then
  ShroudConsoleLog(ShroudGetPartyMemberName(slot) .. " Focus: " .. fp)
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocus¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocus(index: number) -> number Same as ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealth but returns the member's maximum focus. -1 on the same failure and out-of-scene cases.

local slot = 0
local cur = ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocus(slot)
local max = ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocus(slot)
if cur >= 0 and max > 0 then
  ShroudConsoleLog("Focus: " .. cur .. " / " .. max)
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberCountInScene¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberCountInScene() -> number

  • Returns: number, the count of party members present in your current scene. 0 when you are not in a party. This can be lower than ShroudGetPartyMemberCount when some members are in other scenes.
local here = ShroudGetPartyMemberCountInScene()
local total = ShroudGetPartyMemberCount()
ShroudConsoleLog(here .. " of " .. total .. " party members in this scene")

ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene() -> list

  • Returns: list of strings, the names of party members in your current scene. Empty when no party members are in the scene. When you are not in a party the list contains a single nil element rather than being empty, so guard for nil while iterating.
  • Notes: these names are the in-scene entity names and are the correct keys to pass to the InScene health/focus getters.
for _, name in ipairs(ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene()) do
  if name ~= nil then
    local hp = ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene(name)
    ShroudConsoleLog(name .. " HP: " .. hp)
  end
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene(name: string) -> number

  • name: string, the in-scene name of a party member. Matched case-insensitively. Use a name from ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene.
  • Returns: number, that member's current health. -1 when you are not in a party or no in-scene member matches the name.
local names = ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene()
if names[1] ~= nil then
  ShroudConsoleLog("Lead HP: " .. ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene(names[1]))
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealthInScene¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealthInScene(name: string) -> number Same as ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene but returns the member's maximum health. -1 on no match or no party.

local name = ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene()[1]
if name ~= nil then
  local cur = ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene(name)
  local max = ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxHealthInScene(name)
  ShroudConsoleLog(name .. ": " .. cur .. " / " .. max .. " HP")
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocusInScene¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocusInScene(name: string) -> number Same as ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene but returns the member's current focus. -1 on no match or no party.

local name = ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene()[1]
if name ~= nil then
  ShroudConsoleLog(name .. " Focus: " .. ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocusInScene(name))
end

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocusInScene¶

ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocusInScene(name: string) -> number Same as ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentHealthInScene but returns the member's maximum focus. -1 on no match or no party.

local name = ShroudGetPartyMemberNamesInScene()[1]
if name ~= nil then
  local cur = ShroudGetPartyMemberCurrentFocusInScene(name)
  local max = ShroudGetPartyMemberMaxFocusInScene(name)
  ShroudConsoleLog(name .. ": " .. cur .. " / " .. max .. " Focus")
end

Inventory, equipment, decks, emotes¶

Read-only snapshots of the local player's bags, worn gear, combat decks, and emote list, plus the one avatar action in this group (ShroudPlayEmote). Every getter here is fail-soft: when the player, inventory, or deck data is not yet loaded it returns nil (never an empty list), so guard the result before iterating. Item getters return a list whose entries are fixed-order positional tuples; deck getters return a list of deck/card objects with named fields. ShroudSwitchDeck is a stub that always returns false.

Function Call What it does
ShroudGetInventory ShroudGetInventory() All bag items as 14-field tuples
ShroudGetEquipments ShroudGetEquipments() Worn items as 7-field tuples
ShroudCurrentDeck ShroudCurrentDeck() The equipped combat deck
ShroudDeckList ShroudDeckList() All of the player's decks
ShroudGetDeckCardList ShroudGetDeckCardList(name) Cards in one deck, counted
ShroudEmoteList ShroudEmoteList() Names of emotes the player owns
ShroudPlayEmote ShroudPlayEmote(name) Perform an owned emote
ShroudSwitchDeck ShroudSwitchDeck(deck) Stub; always false

ShroudGetInventory¶

ShroudGetInventory() -> list | nil

  • Returns: a list, one entry per item in the player's root inventory container. Each entry is a 14-field tuple, accessed positionally: [1] name (string, localized), [2] durability (number), [3] primary durability (number), [4] max durability (number), [5] weight (number), [6] quantity (number), [7] createdBy (string, crafter's full name, "" if none), [8] creationTime (string, date only, "" if unstamped), [9] creationSceneName (string), [10] length/size (number, fish length or pumpkin size, 0 for other items), [11] value (number, gold), [12] collectedBy (string, PvP trophy collector, "" if not a trophy), [13] collectedDate (string, "" if none), [14] collectedZone (string, "" if none). Returns nil when the player or inventory is not loaded.
  • Notes: fields 12–14 (PvP trophy provenance) are appended at the end so existing positional indexes stay stable; they are empty strings on non-trophy items.
local inv = ShroudGetInventory()
if inv then
    local totalWeight = 0
    for _, item in ipairs(inv) do
        totalWeight = totalWeight + item[5] * item[6]
        ShroudConsoleLog(item[1] .. " x" .. item[6] .. " worth " .. item[11] .. "g")
    end
    ShroudConsoleLog("Carried weight: " .. totalWeight)
end

ShroudGetEquipments¶

ShroudGetEquipments() -> list | nil

  • Returns: a list, one entry per equipped item, each a 7-field tuple: [1] name (string, localized), [2] durability (number), [3] primary durability (number), [4] max durability (number), [5] weight (number), [6] quantity (number), [7] value (number, gold). Returns nil when the local player entity is not loaded.
  • Notes: same leading six fields as ShroudGetInventory, but the tuple ends at value; there are no creation or trophy fields.
local worn = ShroudGetEquipments()
if worn then
    for _, item in ipairs(worn) do
        ShroudConsoleLog(item[1] .. ": " .. item[2] .. "/" .. item[4] .. " durability")
    end
end

ShroudCurrentDeck¶

ShroudCurrentDeck() -> table | nil

  • Returns: the currently equipped combat deck as an object with fields name (string, deck name), quantity (number, card count), and id (string, always ""). Returns nil when no deck is equipped or the player is not loaded.
local deck = ShroudCurrentDeck()
if deck then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Active deck: " .. deck.name .. " (" .. deck.quantity .. " cards)")
end

ShroudDeckList¶

ShroudDeckList() -> list | nil

  • Returns: a list of the player's decks, each an object with name (string), quantity (number, card count in that deck), and id (string, always ""). Returns nil when the player or deck data is not loaded.
local decks = ShroudDeckList()
if decks then
    for _, d in ipairs(decks) do
        ShroudConsoleLog(d.name .. " has " .. d.quantity .. " cards")
    end
end

ShroudGetDeckCardList¶

ShroudGetDeckCardList(name: string) -> list | nil

  • name: string, the deck name to inspect. Pass a name matching one from ShroudDeckList; pass "" (or a name that does not match) to fall back to the currently equipped deck.
  • Returns: a list of the deck's cards, one entry per distinct card, each an object with name (string, card display name), quantity (number, how many copies of that card are in the deck), and id (string, always ""). Returns nil when the player or deck data is not loaded.
  • Notes: duplicate cards are collapsed into one entry with an incremented quantity; locked hotbar slots are added as their own single-count entries.
local cards = ShroudGetDeckCardList("")  -- equipped deck
if cards then
    for _, c in ipairs(cards) do
        ShroudConsoleLog(c.quantity .. "x " .. c.name)
    end
end

ShroudEmoteList¶

ShroudEmoteList() -> list | nil

  • Returns: a list of string emote names the player currently owns (the same set shown in the emote UI). Returns nil when the player is not loaded or owns no emotes (the empty case yields nil, not an empty list).
local emotes = ShroudEmoteList()
if emotes then
    ShroudConsoleLog("You know " .. #emotes .. " emotes")
    for _, name in ipairs(emotes) do
        ShroudConsoleLog(" - " .. name)
    end
end

ShroudPlayEmote¶

ShroudPlayEmote(name: string) -> boolean

  • name: string, the emote name to perform (must be one returned by ShroudEmoteList).
  • Returns: boolean — true when the emote starts, false otherwise (throttled, emote not owned, player off the ground, or player not loaded).
  • Notes: this is the only avatar action in this group and is purely cosmetic. A 2-second throttle applies across all calls, the player must own the emote, and the avatar must be on the ground. A successful call fires the ShroudOnPlayEmote callback with the emote name.
local emotes = ShroudEmoteList()
if emotes and #emotes > 0 then
    if ShroudPlayEmote(emotes[1]) then
        ShroudConsoleLog("Performing " .. emotes[1])
    else
        ShroudConsoleLog("Emote refused (throttle or not grounded)")
    end
end

ShroudSwitchDeck¶

ShroudSwitchDeck(deck: number) -> boolean

  • deck: number, the intended deck index. Ignored.
  • Returns: boolean — always false.
  • Notes: unimplemented stub. It performs no action and never switches decks; do not rely on it. Change decks through the game UI instead.
-- Always returns false; kept only for API compatibility.
if not ShroudSwitchDeck(1) then
    ShroudConsoleLog("ShroudSwitchDeck is a stub and did nothing")
end

Scene and world¶

These functions report the scene the local player is currently in, the in-game clock, the scene's caps and rules, and a world-to-screen projection. They read live client state, so they are only meaningful once you are actually in a scene. Only some of them tolerate not being in a scene yet: ShroudGetGameTime (zeroed table when the clock is unavailable), ShroudWorldToScreenPoint (zeroed vector when the camera is unavailable), and the two dungeon functions (empty string when the plot manager is unavailable) all guard against a not-ready manager. The five scene-name/orientation/max-player/PVP/POT functions do NOT: they dereference the scene stack and skybox manager directly, so calling them before you are in a scene (or before those managers exist) can throw rather than returning a fallback. Call them only once you know you are in a scene. The scene-name functions always return the true engine scene identity even inside a custom-named player dungeon or basement; the owner-set custom name is exposed only through the two dungeon functions.

Function Call What it does
ShroudGetCurrentSceneName ShroudGetCurrentSceneName() Display name of the current scene
ShroudGetCurrentSceneNameRaw ShroudGetCurrentSceneNameRaw() Internal scene id string
ShroudGetCurrentSceneOrientation ShroudGetCurrentSceneOrientation() Compass offset of the scene
ShroudGetCurrentSceneMaxPlayerCount ShroudGetCurrentSceneMaxPlayerCount() Max players the scene allows
ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPVP ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPVP() Whether the scene is PVP
ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPOT ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPOT() Whether the scene is a Player-Owned Town
ShroudGetGameTime ShroudGetGameTime() Current in-game date and time
ShroudGetSceneCap ShroudGetSceneCap() Adventurer level and skill caps
ShroudWorldToScreenPoint ShroudWorldToScreenPoint(x, y, z) Project a world point to screen space
ShroudGetCurrentDungeonName ShroudGetCurrentDungeonName() Owner-set name of the player dungeon
ShroudGetCurrentDungeonOwner ShroudGetCurrentDungeonOwner() Owner character name of the dungeon

ShroudGetCurrentSceneName¶

ShroudGetCurrentSceneName() -> string

  • Returns: string, the human-readable display name of the scene at the top of the scene stack (for example Owl's Head). Never nil; an unresolved scene yields whatever the scene manager maps the id to.
  • Notes: this always reflects the real scene identity, even inside a custom-named player dungeon or basement. Use it (or the raw form) to key logic off a scene rather than the owner-supplied name. Reads the scene stack directly, so only call it once you are in a scene.
local scene = ShroudGetCurrentSceneName()
ShroudConsoleLog("You are in: " .. scene)

ShroudGetCurrentSceneNameRaw¶

ShroudGetCurrentSceneNameRaw() -> string

  • Returns: string, the internal scene id (for example PlayerDungeon_GreenBrickFoyer_3Connections), not the localized display name.
  • Notes: Same as ShroudGetCurrentSceneName but returns the stable internal id string instead of the display name. Prefer this for saved-variable keys and scene comparisons, since it does not change with client language.
if ShroudGetCurrentSceneNameRaw() == "OwlsHead_01" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Welcome back to Owl's Head")
end

ShroudGetCurrentSceneOrientation¶

ShroudGetCurrentSceneOrientation() -> number

  • Returns: number, the scene's compass offset in degrees (the skybox CompassOffset). Used to align a custom compass or minimap with the scene's north.
local offset = ShroudGetCurrentSceneOrientation()
local heading = (ShroudGetPlayerOrientation() + offset) % 360
ShroudConsoleLog("Compass heading: " .. heading)

ShroudGetCurrentSceneMaxPlayerCount¶

ShroudGetCurrentSceneMaxPlayerCount() -> number

  • Returns: number, the maximum number of players the current scene permits, as configured in scene data.
local cap = ShroudGetCurrentSceneMaxPlayerCount()
ShroudConsoleLog("This scene holds up to " .. cap .. " players")

ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPVP¶

ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPVP() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean, true if the current scene is flagged as a PVP scene, false otherwise.
if ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPVP() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("PVP is active here - watch yourself")
end

ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPOT¶

ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPOT() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean, true if the current scene is a Player-Owned Town, false otherwise.
if ShroudGetCurrentSceneIsPOT() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("You are in a Player-Owned Town")
end

ShroudGetGameTime¶

ShroudGetGameTime() -> table

  • Returns: table with the current in-game date and time. Fields: Hour (number, fractional hour of day), Day (number), Month (number), Year (number), PeriodOfDay (string, for example Morning), Season (string). When the game clock is not yet available every field is zeroed and PeriodOfDay/Season are empty strings.
  • Notes: Day and Month are the engine values plus one, so they read as human 1-based calendar numbers (the engine stores them 0-based). Hour is not offset. A zeroed table (Year 0, empty strings) means the clock was unavailable, not literal midnight of year 0.
local t = ShroudGetGameTime()
ShroudConsoleLog(string.format("%s, %d/%d/%d hour %.1f (%s)",
    t.Season, t.Month, t.Day, t.Year, t.Hour, t.PeriodOfDay))

ShroudGetSceneCap¶

ShroudGetSceneCap() -> table

  • Returns: table with two number fields: Level (the adventurer level cap for the current scene) and Skill (the skill cap). Values come from the current scene's cap configuration.
local cap = ShroudGetSceneCap()
ShroudConsoleLog("Level cap " .. cap.Level .. ", skill cap " .. cap.Skill)

ShroudWorldToScreenPoint¶

ShroudWorldToScreenPoint(x: number, y: number, z: number) -> table

  • x, y, z: number, a point in world coordinates to project.
  • Returns: table with number fields x, y, z. x and y are the pixel position in screen space (origin at the bottom-left corner); z is the distance from the camera in world units. When the main camera is unavailable it returns {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0}.
  • Notes: a negative z means the world point is behind the camera, in which case the returned x/y are not a valid on-screen position. Screen-space y runs bottom-up here, unlike widget layout, whose y origin is the top; convert if you position a widget from this result.
local p = ShroudWorldToScreenPoint(100, 20, 250)
if p.z > 0 then
    ShroudConsoleLog("On screen at " .. math.floor(p.x) .. ", " .. math.floor(p.y))
end

ShroudGetCurrentDungeonName¶

ShroudGetCurrentDungeonName() -> string

  • Returns: string, the owner-set name of the player dungeon or basement you are currently inside. Returns "" when you are outside a player dungeon or basement, or when the owner has not named it.
  • Notes: this is the only source of the custom name; the ShroudGetCurrentSceneName* functions keep returning the true scene identity.
local name = ShroudGetCurrentDungeonName()
if name ~= "" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Entering dungeon: " .. name)
end

ShroudGetCurrentDungeonOwner¶

ShroudGetCurrentDungeonOwner() -> string

  • Returns: string, the character name of the owner of the player dungeon or basement you are inside. Returns "" when you are not inside a player dungeon or basement.
  • Notes: Same as ShroudGetCurrentDungeonName but returns the owner's character name instead of the custom area name. The owner name is present even when the area is unnamed, so it can be non-empty while the name is "".
local owner = ShroudGetCurrentDungeonOwner()
if owner ~= "" then
    ShroudConsoleLog("This dungeon belongs to " .. owner)
end

Screen, input, and UI state¶

These read live screen dimensions, window mode, HUD/character-sheet visibility, and raw keyboard state. They query the client on the calling frame, so poll them from ShroudOnUpdate rather than caching. All are read-only: the key functions report state but cannot inject input, and none of these change anything. Key names are Unity KeyCode enum member names (case-sensitive, e.g. "A", "Space", "Escape", "F1", "LeftShift", "Mouse0"); an unrecognized name logs to the addon console and returns false.

Function Call What it does
ShroudGetScreenX ShroudGetScreenX() Screen width in pixels.
ShroudGetScreenY ShroudGetScreenY() Screen height in pixels.
ShroudGetFullScreen ShroudGetFullScreen() Whether the client is fullscreen.
ShroudIsUIActive ShroudIsUIActive() Whether the game HUD is shown.
ShroudIsCharacterSheetActive ShroudIsCharacterSheetActive() Whether the character sheet is open.
ShroudGetCharacterSheetPosition ShroudGetCharacterSheetPosition() Character sheet on-screen position.
ShroudGetKeyDown ShroudGetKeyDown(keyName) Whether a key is currently held.
ShroudGetOnKeyDown ShroudGetOnKeyDown(keyName) Whether a key was pressed this frame.
ShroudGetOnKeyUp ShroudGetOnKeyUp(keyName) Whether a key was released this frame.

ShroudGetScreenX¶

ShroudGetScreenX() -> number

  • Returns: number — the current screen (window) width in pixels (Screen.width).
  • Notes: reflects the live window size, so re-read it after the player resizes the window rather than storing it once at start.
function ShroudOnStart()
    local w = ShroudGetScreenX()
    local h = ShroudGetScreenY()
    ShroudConsoleLog("Screen is " .. w .. "x" .. h)
    -- anchor a panel 210px in from the right edge
    myPanel = ShroudUIPanel(w - 210, 10, 200, 80, 0, 0, UI.Panel, -1)
end

ShroudGetScreenY¶

ShroudGetScreenY() -> number

  • Returns: number — the current screen (window) height in pixels (Screen.height).
  • Notes: same as ShroudGetScreenX but the vertical dimension; re-read after a resize.
local h = ShroudGetScreenY()
ShroudConsoleLog("Screen height: " .. h)

ShroudGetFullScreen¶

ShroudGetFullScreen() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean — true if the client is running fullscreen, false if windowed (Screen.fullScreen).
if ShroudGetFullScreen() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Running fullscreen")
else
    ShroudConsoleLog("Running windowed")
end

ShroudIsUIActive¶

ShroudIsUIActive() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean — true when the game HUD is shown, false when it is hidden (PlayerUI.showHUD).
  • Notes: use it to hide your own widgets in lockstep with the HUD (for example when the player toggles the interface off for a screenshot).
function ShroudOnUpdate()
    if ShroudIsUIActive() then
        ShroudShowObject(myPanel, UI.Panel)
    else
        ShroudHideObject(myPanel, UI.Panel)
    end
end

ShroudIsCharacterSheetActive¶

ShroudIsCharacterSheetActive() -> boolean

  • Returns: boolean — true when the local player's character sheet dialog is open and shown, false when it is closed or the dialog does not exist.
if ShroudIsCharacterSheetActive() then
    ShroudConsoleLog("Character sheet is open")
end

ShroudGetCharacterSheetPosition¶

ShroudGetCharacterSheetPosition() -> number, number

  • Returns: two numbers x, y — the character sheet's on-screen pixel position. Returns nil when the character sheet dialog does not exist (never opened).
  • Notes: the values are pre-adjusted so you can pass them straight to widget positioning. x is measured from the left screen edge (computed as Screen.width + dialogLocalX - 44), and y is already negated to match the top-down coordinate space that ShroudSetPosition expects. Because it returns a tuple, capture both values in one call; guard against nil before using them.
function ShroudOnUpdate()
    if ShroudIsCharacterSheetActive() then
        local x, y = ShroudGetCharacterSheetPosition()
        if x ~= nil then
            -- dock a companion panel next to the character sheet
            ShroudSetPosition(myPanel, UI.Panel, x - 210, y)
            ShroudShowObject(myPanel, UI.Panel)
        end
    else
        ShroudHideObject(myPanel, UI.Panel)
    end
end

ShroudGetKeyDown¶

ShroudGetKeyDown(keyName: string) -> boolean

  • keyName: string — a Unity KeyCode member name, case-sensitive (e.g. "A", "Space", "LeftControl", "F5", "Mouse1").
  • Returns: boolean — true for every frame the key is held down (Input.GetKey). Returns false and logs Keyname invalid: <name> to the console if keyName is not a valid KeyCode.
  • Notes: level-triggered — stays true for the whole hold. Use it for continuous actions; use ShroudGetOnKeyDown for a single edge.
function ShroudOnUpdate()
    if ShroudGetKeyDown("LeftShift") then
        ShroudModifyText(statusLabel, "Sprinting")
    else
        ShroudModifyText(statusLabel, "Walking")
    end
end

ShroudGetOnKeyDown¶

ShroudGetOnKeyDown(keyName: string) -> boolean

  • keyName: string — a Unity KeyCode member name, case-sensitive.
  • Returns: boolean — true only on the single frame the key transitions to pressed (Input.GetKeyDown). Returns false and logs Keyname invalid: <name> for an unrecognized name.
  • Notes: same as ShroudGetKeyDown but edge-triggered on press, so it fires exactly once per keystroke. Poll it from ShroudOnUpdate so you do not miss the one frame it is true.
function ShroudOnUpdate()
    if ShroudGetOnKeyDown("F8") then
        panelVisible = not panelVisible
        if panelVisible then
            ShroudShowObject(myPanel, UI.Panel)
        else
            ShroudHideObject(myPanel, UI.Panel)
        end
    end
end

ShroudGetOnKeyUp¶

ShroudGetOnKeyUp(keyName: string) -> boolean

  • keyName: string — a Unity KeyCode member name, case-sensitive.
  • Returns: boolean — true only on the single frame the key transitions to released (Input.GetKeyUp). Returns false and logs Keyname invalid: <name> for an unrecognized name.
  • Notes: same as ShroudGetOnKeyDown but edge-triggered on release.
function ShroudOnUpdate()
    if ShroudGetOnKeyUp("Space") then
        ShroudConsoleLog("Space released")
    end
end

UI widgets: creating and positioning¶

These functions build the six addon-owned widget kinds and lay them out on the Lua canvas. Every create call returns a 0-based integer id that indexes an internal per-kind list (freed slots are reused), or -1 on failure; a texture-backed widget fails when its texture id is unknown. All later operations take that id plus the widget's UI kind (UI.Panel, UI.Image, UI.Text, UI.Button, UI.Toggle, UI.Input) and return true/false for hit/miss — a wrong kind, negative id, or out-of-range id returns false rather than erroring (the exceptions are noted per function). Widgets anchor to the canvas top-left corner and the y coordinate is negated internally, so y grows downward and a round-trip through ShroudGetPosition gives back the value you passed to ShroudSetPosition.

Function Call What it does
ShroudUIPanel ShroudUIPanel(x, y, width, height, textureID, parentID, parentKind, depth) Create a draggable panel (optional texture)
ShroudUIImage ShroudUIImage(x, y, width, height, textureID, parentID, parentKind, depth) Create a textured image widget
ShroudUIText ShroudUIText(text, fontSize, x, y, width, height, parentID, parentKind, depth) Create a text label
ShroudUIButton ShroudUIButton(x, y, width, height, textureID, parentID, parentKind, depth) Create a clickable button (needs a texture)
ShroudUIInput ShroudUIInput(x, y, width, height, parentID, parentKind) Create a text input field
ShroudUIToggle ShroudUIToggle(x, y, width, height, parentID, parentKind) Create a checkbox toggle
ShroudSetPosition ShroudSetPosition(id, kind, x, y) Move a widget (y negated)
ShroudGetPosition ShroudGetPosition(id, kind) Read a widget's position
ShroudSetSize ShroudSetSize(id, kind, width, height) Resize a widget
ShroudSetScale ShroudSetScale(id, kind, scale) Uniformly scale a widget
ShroudSetPivot ShroudSetPivot(id, kind, x, y) Set the pivot point
ShroudSetAnchorMin ShroudSetAnchorMin(id, kind, x, y) Set the min anchor
ShroudSetAnchorMax ShroudSetAnchorMax(id, kind, x, y) Set the max anchor
ShroudRotateObject ShroudRotateObject(id, kind, degrees) Set absolute Z rotation
ShroudSetColor ShroudSetColor(id, kind, hexColor) Tint a widget (not Button)
ShroudSetTransparency ShroudSetTransparency(id, kind, alpha) Set a widget's alpha
ShroudModifyImage ShroudModifyImage(id, kind, textureID) Swap a widget's sprite (not Text)
ShroudModifyText ShroudModifyText(id, text) Replace a text label's string
ShroudSetTextAlignment ShroudSetTextAlignment(id, anchor) Align text within its rect
ShroudSetFontSize ShroudSetFontSize(id, kind, size) Set text/input font size
ShroudSetMask ShroudSetMask(id, kind) Clip children to an Image (or re-add a Panel's mask)
ShroudUnsetMask ShroudUnsetMask(id, kind) Remove a mask

ShroudUIPanel¶

ShroudUIPanel(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, textureID: number, parentID: number, parentKind: UI, depth: number) -> number

  • x, y: number, pixel offset of the top-left corner from the canvas top-left; y is negated internally so positive y is downward.
  • width, height: number, size in pixels.
  • textureID: number, a texture id from ShroudLoadTexture; pass -1 for an untextured (blank) panel. Optional, defaults -1.
  • parentID: number, id of the parent widget, or -1 for the canvas. Optional, defaults -1.
  • parentKind: UI, kind of the parent; a panel may parent under UI.Image, UI.Text, UI.Panel, or UI.Button (anything else falls back to the canvas). Optional, defaults UI.None.
  • depth: number, accepted for signature compatibility but not applied. Optional, defaults -1.
  • Returns: number, the new panel's 0-based id, or -1 if textureID was given (not -1) but no texture with that id exists.
  • Notes: panels are draggable and receive mouse enter/exit callbacks by default. A panel is created with a Unity Mask component already attached, so it clips its children to its own rect without any ShroudSetMask call.
local tex = ShroudLoadTexture("panel_bg.png")
local panel = ShroudUIPanel(40, 60, 300, 200, tex)
if panel == -1 then
    ShroudConsoleLog("panel texture failed to load")
else
    ShroudConsoleLog("panel id = " .. panel)
end

ShroudUIImage¶

ShroudUIImage(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, textureID: number, parentID: number, parentKind: UI, depth: number) -> number

  • x, y: number, top-left offset from the canvas top-left; y negated internally.
  • width, height: number, size in pixels.
  • textureID: number, a texture id from ShroudLoadTexture. Required — there is no blank-image form.
  • parentID: number, parent widget id, or -1 for the canvas. Optional, defaults -1.
  • parentKind: UI, parent kind (UI.Image, UI.Text, UI.Panel, UI.Button, else canvas). Optional, defaults UI.None.
  • depth: number, accepted but not applied. Optional, defaults -1.
